title: Plain G1 DLOG: P10 STNFS core + run rule, PREREG-G/H, seven owners, Horner chains: 122.748017907765838

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b, maps both into the tower (field-map.md), computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. Core: our valid plain P10 9c904850's (pool D, relations >= 2^63.6016); collection (allowance 1.0048) <= 2^119.180693087 units. rec7 walks a listed run only if all its a-values are canonical; work missed on other rows is bounded by a cell-weighted exhaustive sample (2,880 rows, 0 affected, q <= 0.00248) times the enclosure 47 per cell: reserve row 2^108.537; listed-run ends 2^75 (recover-P d9702282's run rule). Filtering charge N(300)/U = 0.03577 (PREREG-H: mean + 2 SE at 2^19, 2^20): N <= 2^58.6463 < 7 x 2^56, seven owners (row tail 1,320), Block Wiedemann (28, 5): Horner in five chains from Krylov checkpoints: linear algebra <= 2^116.621811206, generator <= 2^107.328830867; descent meter 2^113.104; core ledger rows sum to <= 2^119.4253288799 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work (all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, field map, pairings, sampling, verification, output) is at most 10 x (2^119.4253288799 + 2^108.537 + 2^75) + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.748017907765838 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice, no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, probes, lazy bound, core ledger and success, run rule, G1 conversion (80-digit), base bijections. {"descent": true} reruns the descent recurrence.
Optional: filtsim at excess 1.05 and the shipped means to weight 100/200/300; reports the +-1 share of row weight (charged 0.87) and U/N. Toy scale only (H4u, H3).
Optional: {"mode":"dmax"} recomputes the enclosure U(S_min) and checks d <= U on a grid (about 1 minute); {"mode":"replay","seed":s} redraws a sample seed's first row and tests its whole run.
